name: south-florida-economic-report
what_it_holds: Streamlit + Plotly dashboard for Palm Beach, Broward, and Miami-Dade counties combining BLS QCEW, FRED, and IRS SOI data. MIT-licensed. A near-identical fork exists for Michigan's Upper Peninsula (joshuaingber/upper-peninsula-economic-report).
why_useful: South Florida is a tourism/STR-relevant metro; a reusable QCEW+FRED dashboard template could be repointed at other Inside-Airbnb panel markets (Austin, New Orleans) to pull county-level leisure & hospitality wage/employment series quickly.
geography: 3 South Florida counties (fork covers Michigan Upper Peninsula, 15 counties)
size_hint: dashboard app, no large static files
themes: Hospitality labour and cost data: BLS QCEW/CES leisure and hospitality, hotel wages, cleaning-service prices, STR operating cost datasets
why_all: South Florida is a tourism/STR-relevant metro; a reusable QCEW+FRED dashboard template could be repointed at other Inside-Airbnb panel markets (Austin, New Orleans) to pull county-level leisure & hospitality wage/employment series quickly.

name: austin-area-labor-market-analysis
what_it_holds: Excel-based labor market and wage analysis of Bastrop and Caldwell Counties, Texas (Austin metro fringe) using BLS QCEW data for Q4 2024-Q4 2025, covering employment growth, industry contributions, and wage dynamics.
why_useful: Austin is one of our 13 Inside Airbnb panel cities; county-adjacent QCEW wage/employment detail for the metro could support a local labor-cost cross-check, though the file is Excel-based and industry breakout (whether leisure/hospitality specifically) is unconfirmed.
themes: Hospitality labour and cost data: BLS QCEW/CES leisure and hospitality, hotel wages, cleaning-service prices, STR operating cost datasets
why_all: Austin is one of our 13 Inside Airbnb panel cities; county-adjacent QCEW wage/employment detail for the metro could support a local labor-cost cross-check, though the file is Excel-based and industry breakout (whether leisure/hospitality specifically) is unconfirmed.

name: interstate-wage-gaps
what_it_holds: Analysis of US state and county wage gaps 2004-2024 using BLS QCEW data, framed around industry-driven churn reshaping regional wage rankings (aggregate geographic inequality stable, but industry composition shifted).
why_useful: 20-year state/county QCEW wage panel; if it retains industry-level cuts, could isolate leisure/hospitality wage growth by state as a regional labor-cost input, but the industry breakout depth is unconfirmed from the description alone.
themes: Hospitality labour and cost data: BLS QCEW/CES leisure and hospitality, hotel wages, cleaning-service prices, STR operating cost datasets
why_all: 20-year state/county QCEW wage panel; if it retains industry-level cuts, could isolate leisure/hospitality wage growth by state as a regional labor-cost input, but the industry breakout depth is unconfirmed from the description alone.

name: jp-qcew
what_it_holds: Pipeline (Polars/DuckDB, GPLv3, 92 commits) that reads raw fixed-width QCEW text files (2003 onward) and outputs partitioned Parquet with employment indices, total/taxable wages, and geospatial establishment coordinates by industry and geography. Development has moved to Codeberg; GitHub copy still functional as a processing reference.
why_useful: Faster QCEW-to-Parquet processing path than raw BLS text files if the team wants county-level leisure & hospitality (NAICS 70-72) employment/wage series as a labour-cost input to the margin model.
themes: Hospitality labour and cost data: BLS QCEW/CES leisure and hospitality, hotel wages, cleaning-service prices, STR operating cost datasets
why_all: Faster QCEW-to-Parquet processing path than raw BLS text files if the team wants county-level leisure & hospitality (NAICS 70-72) employment/wage series as a labour-cost input to the margin model.

name: qcew
what_it_holds: MIT-licensed Python scripts (extract_data.py, extract_data_08_12.py) that extract data from BLS QCEW; small repo (1 star, 4 commits), no data committed.
why_useful: Alternative lightweight QCEW extraction script; marginal value over qcew-data given no data committed and minimal documentation.
